visual_tokens: SOURCE: concept-bundle/bundle/app_sizes/index.html. Everything is inline styles. The x-dc script is `class Component extends DCLogic { renderVals() { return {}; } }`, so the board is fully static: no {{bindings}}, no <sc-if>, no <sc-for>. Hex values below are converted from oklch and checked against pixel samples from page4.png.

FONT FAMILY: 'Manrope', fallbacks ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif (set on body). Self-hosted woff2 with font-display: swap and font-style normal. Four weights are declared (500, 600, 700, 800), each in six unicode subsets (cyrillic-ext, cyrillic, greek, vietnamese, latin-ext, latin) = 24 @font-face rules. Every weight points to the same file per subset, so it is a variable font. Latin file: 63f11a9c-e39d-4557-a974-b5960fdd2afb.woff2. Latin-ext: 6ce9940c-…woff2. Vietnamese: 1061af14-…woff2. Greek: 3a744c16-…woff2. Cyrillic: 9ee30b13-…woff2. Cyrillic-ext: 8c20813b-…woff2. Weights actually used on this board: 400 (default body), 700 and 800. 500 and 600 are declared but unused.
BASE TEXT: the canvas wrapper sets font-size 15px and line-height 1.5. body: margin 0, background oklch(0.975 0.006 275), color #0E153E.

COLOUR #0E153E (navy ink, the primary/brand ink): body text, link colour (`a{color:#0E153E}`), widget titles, active filter-chip text, Synergy pill text, selected routine-chip border and text, <strong> partner name, progress-bar fill, S-size Synergy status dot, M 'Continue to briefing' button background, footer links ('+6 more', 'History · 8 sessions →', 'Full history →'), '340 / 500'.
COLOUR #09102E: link hover colour (`a:hover{color:#09102E}`).
COLOUR oklch(0.975 0.006 275) ≈ #F5F6FB (pixel sample rgb 245,246,251): page/canvas background, Solo mode-pill background, size-badge background.
COLOUR oklch(0.998 0.002 275) ≈ #FEFEFF: widget card surface.
COLOUR oklch(0.9 0.012 275) ≈ #DBDEE6: card border, header bottom divider, row dividers, XL column-header divider, Start M footer top rule, Credits M stats-row top rule.
COLOUR oklch(0.84 0.018 275) ≈ #C7CAD7 (dot pixel sample ~#C9C9D3): canvas dot-grid dots, unselected routine-chip border, S picker-button border.

COLOUR oklch(0.5 0.035 275) ≈ #5D6278 (Solo pill text pixel ~#5F6376): muted/secondary text. Used for section labels, size-badge text, inactive filter-chip text, Solo pill text, row meta lines, scenario cells, '—' empty-partner cells, dates, XL column headers, '5 of 8 sessions', header subtitles, partner sentence, '160 to Proficient', the ' credits' unit, the streak line, stat captions.

COLOUR oklch(0.93 0.03 275) ≈ #E2E7FD (pixel sample rgb 226,231,253): accent tint. Used for the active filter chip ('All') background, Synergy pill background, selected routine-chip ('Flight') background and the progress-bar track.
COLOUR oklch(0.68 0.025 275) ≈ #9397A8 (pixel sample rgb 148,151,167): S-size Solo status dot.
COLOUR #BD2025 (brand red): S-size 'Continue to briefing' icon button background. #fff is the on-primary icon and text colour for both the red S button and the navy M button.
DOT GRID (canvas): background-color oklch(0.975 0.006 275); background-image radial-gradient(oklch(0.84 0.018 275) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size 24px 24px; background-position 12px 12px.

TYPE SCALE: 34px/800, letter-spacing -0.02em, line-height 1 = Credits M hero number '180'. 28px/800, -0.02em, lh 1 = Credits S hero number '180'. 15px/800 = every widget title (ellipsis, flex 1). 15px/700 = row titles at M, L, XL (inherited 15px). 14px/700 = S row titles, routine chips, S picker label, ' credits' unit (14px/700 muted, letter-spacing 0). 14px/400 = partner sentence. 13px/800 uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em, muted = board section labels. 13px/700 = M footer 'History · 8 sessions →' and '340 / 500' (tabular-nums). 13px/400 = row meta lines, scenario/partner/date cells, header subtitles, XL footer, streak line, stats row. 12px/700 = mode pills, filter chips, S footer '+6 more', Credits S hint '160 to Proficient'. 12px/700 uppercase, letter-spacing 0.05em = XL column headers. 11px/800 = size badge. <strong> (bold) = stat numbers '+40', '3', '1' and the partner name.
NUMERALS: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every date cell (L, XL) and on '340 / 500'.
RADII: 12px on everything rounded: cards, pills, filter chips, size badges, routine chips, picker button, both primary buttons, progress track and fill. 999px for the 8px status dots.
BORDERS: always 1px solid. Cards and dividers use #DBDEE6. Controls (unselected chips, picker) use #C7CAD7. The selected chip uses #0E153E.
SHADOWS: none on any element of this board (cards are flat, border only).

SIZE BADGE (header meta): font-size 11px, weight 800, padding 2px 7px, radius 12px, background #F5F6FB, colour #5D6278. Text pattern '<Size> · <cols>×<rows>' with a middle dot and the multiplication sign × (U+00D7), e.g. 'S · 3×2'.
MODE PILL: font-size 12px, weight 700, padding 3px 9px, radius 12px. Synergy = background #E2E7FD, text #0E153E. Solo = background #F5F6FB, text #5D6278. Has flex-shrink 0 in M rows.

FILTER CHIP (L and XL headers): same box as the mode pill (12px/700, padding 3px 9px, radius 12px), in a group with gap 4px. Active ('All') = background #E2E7FD, text #0E153E. Inactive ('Solo', 'Synergy') = no background, text #5D6278.
STATUS DOT (S rows): 8×8px, border-radius 999px, flex-shrink 0. Navy #0E153E = Synergy session. Grey #9397A8 = Solo session.

ROUTINE CHIP (Start M): inline-flex, height 40px, padding 0 16px, radius 12px, 14px/700. Selected = border 1px #0E153E, background #E2E7FD, text #0E153E. Unselected = border 1px #C7CAD7, no background, inherited text colour.

PICKER BUTTON (Start S): height 44px, padding 0 14px, radius 12px, border 1px #C7CAD7, background transparent, 14px/700, flex 1, min-width 0, justify space-between, gap 8px. Trailing chevron-down SVG: 16×16, viewBox 0 0 24 24, stroke currentColor, stroke-width 2, round caps and joins, path 'M6 9l6 6 6-6'.
PRIMARY ICON BUTTON (Start S): 44×44px, radius 12px, background #BD2025, colour #fff, flex-shrink 0. Play SVG: 20×20, filled currentColor, path 'M7 4l13 8-13 8z'.
PRIMARY TEXT BUTTON (Start M): inline-flex, height 44px, padding 0 22px, radius 12px, background #0E153E, colour #fff, weight 700, white-space nowrap, no underline.
PROGRESS BAR: track height 8px, radius 12px, background #E2E7FD, overflow hidden. Fill width 68%, height 100%, background #0E153E, radius 12px.
SPACING, card header: S = padding 10px 14px. M, L, XL = padding 12px 16px. Header is flex, align-items center, gap 10px, border-bottom 1px #DBDEE6.

SPACING, rows: S = height 40px, padding 0 14px, gap 8px. M = height 56px, padding 0 18px, gap 10px (two lines). L and XL = height 48px, padding 0 18px, grid gap 12px. Rows are divided by 1px #DBDEE6 bottom borders; the last row has none.
SPACING, footers: S = padding 0 14px 8px. M and XL = padding 0 18px 10px. Footers are pushed to the bottom with margin-top auto.

SPACING, widget bodies: Start S = padding 14px, gap 10px. Start M = padding 16px 18px 18px, column gap 16px, chip gap 8px, footer gap 12px, footer padding-top 16px. Credits S = padding 12px 14px, gap 8px. Credits M = padding 16px 18px 18px, gap 10px, stats row gap 16px and padding-top 6px.

UTILITY CLASSES: .ell = white-space nowrap, overflow hidden, text-overflow ellipsis. It is on every title, meta, scenario and partner text and on the subtitles. .clamp2 = 2-line -webkit-line-clamp; it is defined but unused on this board. `button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}`.
DARK THEME: none. The board defines no dark-mode values, no prefers-color-scheme rules and no theme tokens.
ACCENT OPTIONS: none on this board.
layout_system:
BOARD FRAME: the board is 'Widget sizes · S / M / L / XL on the same grid' (shell label in template.html). Its document <title> is 'Widget sizes: how content adapts to the span'. It is designed at 1440px wide; data-props $preview is {width:1440, height:1120}. The board shell iframe is only 1440×800, so the PDF export (page4.png, 2160×1200 = 1.5× of 1440×800) is clipped. page4.png shows all four Recent routines spans, the second section label and the two 'Start a routine' header bars. It does NOT show the Start a routine bodies or either Credits widget; those exist only in the source. The computed full content height is about 1319px, which exceeds even the declared 1120 preview.

CANVAS WRAPPER: width 1440px, box-sizing border-box, padding 20px 114px 40px, so the content width is 1212px. Flex column, gap 40px between the two sections. Dot-grid background as in tokens. Each section is a flex column with gap 12px: an uppercase section label (13px/800, 0.06em, muted; 19.5px line), then a grid.

GRID (identical in both sections): display grid; grid-template-columns repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-auto-rows 72px; gap 20px (column and row gutters). Derived cell size at 1212px: column = (1212 − 11×20)/12 ≈ 82.67px wide; row = 72px tall. One span unit adds 20px of gutter.

SPAN TO PIXELS: width = n×82.67 + (n−1)×20 and height = r×72 + (r−1)×20. Cols 3 → 288px, 4 → 390.67px, 5 → 493.33px, 7 → 698.67px, 8 → 801.33px. Rows 2 → 164px, 3 → 256px, 4 → 348px. This was checked against the screenshot: the S card is about 286px wide and the XL card about 346px tall.

SIZE CLASSES (rows × cols written as cols×rows, as on the badges). Recent routines: S = 3×2, M = 4×3, L = 5×3, XL = 8×4. Start a routine: S = 4×2, M = 7×3. Credits: S = 3×2, M = 5×3. S is always 2 rows tall, M and L are 3 rows, XL is 4 rows. Width per size varies by widget (S is 3 or 4 columns, M is 4, 5 or 7 columns), so sizes are named classes per widget, not fixed pixel boxes. The desktop canvas board uses exactly the M spans as defaults: Start a routine c7×3, Credits and tier c5×3, Recent routines c4×3. Its other widgets there are Weekly insight 4×3, Consented partners 4×3, My report 3×3, Rewards catalog 5×3, plus an 'Empty grid slot: where a new or resized widget snaps' placeholder.

PLACEMENT: items carry only `grid-column: span N; grid-row: span N` with the default sparse auto-flow. There is no explicit line placement and no dense packing. Section 1 resolves to: S at rows 1–2, cols 1–3; M at rows 1–3, cols 4–7; L at rows 1–3, cols 8–12; XL at rows 4–7, cols 1–8. That leaves an empty cell under S at row 3, cols 1–3, and an empty block at rows 4–7, cols 9–12, both visible as bare dot grid in the screenshot. Section 2 resolves to: Start S at rows 1–2, cols 1–4; Start M at rows 1–3, cols 5–11; col 12 empty; Credits S at rows 3–4, cols 1–3; Credits M at rows 4–6, cols 4–8.

CARD BOX: display flex, flex-direction column, overflow hidden, so content that does not fit is clipped and never scrolls. Footers use margin-top auto to stick to the bottom.

CORE RULE (section label, verbatim): 'Recent routines · same widget, four spans. Text never scales; the amount shown does.' and 'Start a routine & Credits · at S the primary action stays, chips collapse to a picker, secondary text goes to the left bar'. Type size is constant across sizes. What changes is the number of rows, columns and fields, the header meta (filters), the footers, and the inline secondary text.

Prototype exceptions to 'text never scales': S row titles are 14px against 15px at M and up. The Credits hero number is 28px at S against 34px at M. S header padding is 10px 14px against 12px 16px.

FIT AND OVERFLOW (computed):
- Recent routines S needs about 150px of the 164px.
- Recent routines M needs about 247px of 256px.
- Recent routines L needs about 244px of 256px.
- Recent routines XL needs about 357px against 346px of inner height. The flex items (48px rows) shrink to about 46–47px. The screenshot confirms rows are compressed (about 46.8px pitch). An implementation should cap rows by available height or reduce to 4 rows.
- Start S uses about 116px of 164px (blank space below).
- Start M uses about 199px of 256px.
- Credits S uses about 112px of 164px.
- Credits M uses about 200px of 256px.

L/XL TABLE ALIGNMENT: every L and XL row is its own grid with the same template but `auto` tracks. Pill and date widths differ per row, so the fr columns resolve differently and the Scenario column visibly starts at a slightly different x on each row (screenshot: 'Go-around…' sits right of '787 ·…'). A real build should use one shared grid, subgrid or table so columns align.

DRAG, RESIZE AND SNAPPING: not on this board. It shows static results only, with no resize handles, no free-cell placeholder and no snapping behaviour. The desktop board's contextual left bar has a 'Resize widget' tool (label 'Resize', expand-arrows icon), which is where these size classes would be chosen.

BREAKPOINTS AND PHONE: not defined on this board. There are no media queries and it is a fixed 1440px design. Phone behaviour is specified on the separate Phone board.
chrome: MAIN (BOTTOM) BAR: not present on this board.

CONTEXTUAL LEFT BAR: not rendered on this board. It is referenced only by the section-2 rule '…secondary text goes to the left bar': at S, the header subtitle ('Solo, or with a consenting partner'; 'Ready → Proficient') and the long secondary lines (partner sentence, streak line, stats) leave the widget and appear in the contextual left bar when the widget is selected. On the desktop board that left bar holds 'Pin' (aria-label 'Pin widget'), 'Resize' ('Resize widget'), 'Hide' ('Hide widget') and 'Esc' ('Deselect').
TOP BARS: none. There is no app header, no search and no theme toggle on this board.

WIDGET HEADER BAR (on all 8 cards): a <div>, not a button. It differs from the desktop board, where the title bar is a <button aria-label='Select widget: …'> with a drag-grip glyph. Display flex, align-items center, gap 10px, bottom border 1px #DBDEE6, padding 10px 14px at S and 12px 16px at M/L/XL. Children in order: (1) title span, 15px/800, flex 1, ellipsis; (2) optional subtitle span, 13px muted, ellipsis, M only for Start and Credits; (3) optional filter-chip group, L and XL Recent routines only; (4) size badge.

SIZE BADGE (rightmost in every header), exact texts: 'S · 3×2' (Recent routines S, Credits S), 'M · 4×3' (Recent routines M), 'L · 5×3', 'XL · 8×4', 'S · 4×2' (Start S), 'M · 7×3' (Start M), 'M · 5×3' (Credits M). The badge is static and not interactive. It reads as a designer annotation of the span.
FILTER CHIPS in the header (Recent routines L and XL only): 'All' (active, tinted), 'Solo', 'Synergy' (inactive, muted text). They are <span>s with no handler in the prototype.
HEADER SUBTITLES (M only): 'Solo, or with a consenting partner' (Start a routine M) and 'Ready → Proficient' (Credits & tier M). They are absent at S.

SECTION LABELS (board annotations, rendered uppercase via CSS): 'Recent routines · same widget, four spans. Text never scales; the amount shown does.' and 'Start a routine & Credits · at S the primary action stays, chips collapse to a picker, secondary text goes to the left bar'.

widgets.title: Recent routines
widgets.default_span: M · 4×3 (the desktop canvas board places 'Recent routines' at c4 × 3 rows). Shown here at S · 3×2, M · 4×3, L · 5×3, XL · 8×4.
widgets.header_meta: S: size badge 'S · 3×2' only. M: badge 'M · 4×3' only. L: filter chips 'All' (active) / 'Solo' / 'Synergy' then badge 'L · 5×3'. XL: the same filter chips then badge 'XL · 8×4'. Title text is always 'Recent routines' at every size.
widgets.content:
Dataset is 8 sessions in total, implied by '+6 more' (2 shown + 6), 'History · 8 sessions →' and '5 of 8 sessions'. Five are spelled out. Fields per session: routine name, date, short scenario, long scenario, partner, mode.
(1) 'Flight briefing'. Date 'Today'. Short scenario '787 · Night approach'. Long scenario '787 · Night approach into TLV, gusty crosswind' (ellipsised in the screenshot as '787 · Night approach into TLV, gusty cro…'). Partner 'Yoav F.'. Mode Synergy.
(2) 'Event debrief'. Date '3 Oct'. Short 'Go-around, LLWS'. Long 'Go-around after LLWS alert at 400 ft'. Partner '—'. Mode Solo.
(3) 'Simulator briefing'. Date '29 Sep'. Short 'Engine failure sim'. Long 'Engine failure after V1, recurrent sim'. Partner 'Yoav F.'. Mode Synergy.
(4) 'Coaching guidance'. Date '22 Sep'. Short 'Line check prep'. Long 'Line check preparation'. Partner '—'. Mode Solo.
(5) 'Training briefing'. Date '18 Sep'. Short n/a, shown only at XL. Long 'CRM refresher, day 2'. Partner 'Dana C.'. Mode Synergy.
Rows are newest first. Mode pill labels are exactly 'Synergy' and 'Solo'. The empty partner is an em dash '—' in muted colour. A present partner name is 13px in normal ink, not muted. Scenario copy is hand-shortened per size (the L text differs from the XL text, rather than being ellipsis-truncated), so the data model needs a short summary and a full scenario, or the shortening is editorial.
widgets.sizes:
S · 3×2 (288×164px). Header padding 10px 14px. Shows 2 rows, each a 40px link (padding 0 14px, gap 8px): routine name only (14px/700, ellipsis) and, right-aligned, an 8px status dot coloured by mode. Row 1 'Flight briefing' has a navy #0E153E dot (Synergy). Row 2 'Event debrief' has a grey #9397A8 dot (Solo). A divider sits between the rows. Footer '+6 more' (12px/700, navy, padding 0 14px 8px, bottom-anchored). No date, scenario, partner, pill or filters.

M · 4×3 (390.67×256px). Shows 3 two-line rows, each a 56px link (padding 0 18px, gap 10px). Left: name (15px/700, ellipsis) over a meta line (13px muted, ellipsis) formatted '<date> · <short scenario>': 'Today · 787 · Night approach', '3 Oct · Go-around, LLWS', '29 Sep · Engine failure sim'. Right: mode pill 'Synergy' / 'Solo' / 'Synergy'. Footer 'History · 8 sessions →' (13px/700, navy, padding 0 18px 10px). No filters and no partner.

L · 5×3 (493.33×256px). Header gains the filter chips 'All' (active) / 'Solo' / 'Synergy'. Shows 4 single-line rows, each a 48px grid link with columns minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(0,1fr) auto auto (gap 12px, padding 0 18px): name (15px/700) | short scenario (13px muted) | mode pill | date (13px muted, tabular-nums). Rows: 'Flight briefing' · '787 · Night approach' · Synergy · 'Today'; 'Event debrief' · 'Go-around, LLWS' · Solo · '3 Oct'; 'Simulator briefing' · 'Engine failure sim' · Synergy · '29 Sep'; 'Coaching guidance' · 'Line check prep' · Solo · '22 Sep'. No footer and no count. No partner column.

XL · 8×4 (801.33×348px). Same header chips. Adds a column-header row (padding 8px 18px, 12px/700 uppercase, letter-spacing 0.05em, muted, bottom border) with 'Routine', 'Scenario', 'Partner', 'Mode', 'Date' (rendered ROUTINE / SCENARIO / PARTNER / MODE / DATE). Shows 5 rows, 48px grid links with columns minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(0,1.6fr) minmax(0,1fr) auto auto: name | long scenario | partner | mode pill | date. Rows: 'Flight briefing' · '787 · Night approach into TLV, gusty crosswind' · 'Yoav F.' · Synergy · 'Today'; 'Event debrief' · 'Go-around after LLWS alert at 400 ft' · '—' · Solo · '3 Oct'; 'Simulator briefing' · 'Engine failure after V1, recurrent sim' · 'Yoav F.' · Synergy · '29 Sep'; 'Coaching guidance' · 'Line check preparation' · '—' · Solo · '22 Sep'; 'Training briefing' · 'CRM refresher, day 2' · 'Dana C.' · Synergy · '18 Sep'. Footer row (flex, space-between, padding 0 18px 10px, 13px): left '5 of 8 sessions' (muted), right 'Full history →' (700, navy). Content slightly exceeds 348px, so rows compress to about 46–47px.

Rule: the field set grows with the span. S = name + mode dot. M = + date, scenario summary and mode pill. L = + filters, one-line columns and one more row. XL = + column headers, partner column, long scenario, fifth row and a 'n of N' count.
widgets.primary_action: Open a session: every row (S, M, L, XL) is a whole-row <a> link. There is no separate button.
widgets.opens: Every row link has href 'Sizes.dc.html', a self-referencing placeholder; on the desktop board the equivalent rows point to 'Main.dc.html'. The intended targets are the session's detail and output page, and the full routine history page. The footer affordances '+6 more', 'History · 8 sessions →' and 'Full history →' are plain <div>/<span> text, not links, in this prototype. The arrows imply navigation to the full history list.
widgets.left_bar_actions: Not shown on this board. Implied: when selected, the left bar carries the content dropped at smaller sizes (filters, counts) plus the generic Pin / Resize / Hide / Esc tools from the desktop board.
widgets.action_sheet: Not defined on this board (see the Phone board).
widgets.states: Only the populated state is shown, with the 'All' filter active. No empty, loading, error, locked or disabled states and no hover or selected visuals beyond the global link hover colour #09102E. No 'no partner' variant other than the '—' cell.

interactions: STATIC BOARD: the DCLogic component returns no values. There are no sc-on-click handlers, no state, no selection, no drag, no resize, no reset, no lock, no search, no theme toggle, no guide and no keyboard shortcuts. Nothing animates (no transitions or keyframes are defined).

NON-INTERACTIVE ELEMENTS that look actionable: the filter chips 'All' / 'Solo' / 'Synergy' (L, XL) are <span>s. The footers '+6 more', 'History · 8 sessions →' and 'Full history →' are <div>/<span>s. The routine chips 'Flight' / 'Simulator' / 'Training' / 'Debrief' / 'Coaching' are <span>s. The size badges are <span>s. In production these need to be buttons or links: the filter as a segmented control or radio group, the routine chips as a radio group, the footers as links to history.

PICKER: <button type="button" aria-label="Routine: Flight"> with the visible label 'Flight · Yoav F.' and a chevron. No menu is defined. The intent is that at S the chip row collapses into this picker, which opens a choice of routine (and partner).

SIZE ADAPTATION RULES as stated on the board: 'same widget, four spans', 'Text never scales; the amount shown does.', 'at S the primary action stays, chips collapse to a picker, secondary text goes to the left bar'.

SIZE ADAPTATION RULES as observed: S shows the minimum (names + mode dot, or picker + icon action, or hero number + bar), with header meta reduced to the badge. M adds second-line meta, pills, subtitles, full labels and a history link. L converts rows to single-line columns and adds filter chips and one more row. XL adds column headers, extra columns (partner), the longer copy, more rows and an 'n of N' count with a 'Full history →' link.

TRUNCATION: every text cell uses .ell (single line, ellipsis); nothing wraps except the chip row and the Start M footer (flex-wrap). Cards clip overflow (overflow hidden); there is no in-widget scrolling.

ACCESSIBILITY in the source: the progress bar has role="progressbar", aria-label="Tier progress", aria-valuenow="68", aria-valuemin="0", aria-valuemax="100". The icon-only S button has aria-label "Continue to briefing". The picker has aria-label "Routine: Flight". The SVGs have aria-hidden="true". The S status dots have no text alternative, so the mode (Synergy or Solo) is conveyed by colour only.

open_questions: Mode label mismatch: this board's pills and filters say 'Synergy', but the desktop canvas board's Recent routines rows say 'Blind synergy', and the repo copy uses 'Blind Synergy' (src/app/app/routines/page.tsx). Which label is canonical for pills and filters?

Primary-action colour: at S the 'Continue to briefing' icon button is red #BD2025, while at M on this board it is navy #0E153E. The desktop board's M 'Continue to briefing' is red #BD2025. Which is intended: is red the primary action in all sizes?

Credits numbers: the hero is '180' credits, but the tier progress is '340 / 500' (68%) and '160 to Proficient' (500 − 340). Is 180 a spendable balance and 340 the lifetime or tier credits? The repo's tierProgress(totalCredits, tiers) derives percent and creditsToNext from a single total.

Tier naming: the design uses 'Ready → Proficient', but the repo seeds readiness_tiers bronze/silver/gold/platinum with labels 'Tier 1 - Bronze', 'Tier 2 - Silver', 'Tier 3 - Gold' (supabase/migrations/20260914000000_init.sql). Rename the tiers, or map design names onto the existing ones?

Consent window: the copy says 'approved, valid 14 days', but in the repo a consent request expires_at is 14 days while an approval sets valid_until to now() + 30 days. Which window is the one to display, and should the copy be data-driven (days remaining)?

Coaching and partners: the routine chips include 'Coaching', but consent_requests.routine_type allows only simulator, flight, debrief and training. What should the partner line or picker show when Coaching (solo-only) is selected, and what does the S picker label show with no partner, or with a pending or expired consent?
Size badges ('S · 3×2' etc.) appear in every header: are they production UI (for example shown only while resizing or selected), or designer annotations to drop?

Only Recent routines has all four sizes. Start a routine and Credits show only S and M; L and XL are undefined. Weekly insight, Consented partners, My report and Rewards catalog have no size spec at all. Which sizes does each widget allow, and what does each show?

S width is not uniform (Recent routines S = 3 columns, Start S = 4 columns), and M varies (4, 5 or 7 columns). Is a size class per-widget (a named preset of cols×rows), or should S/M/L/XL map to fixed spans across all widgets?
XL overflow: 5 rows + column header + footer need about 357px but XL is 348px, so rows compress. Should XL show 4 rows, or should row height be 44px or the row cap be computed from available height?

Scenario copy differs by size ('Go-around, LLWS' at L vs 'Go-around after LLWS alert at 400 ft' at XL; 'Line check prep' vs 'Line check preparation'). Is there a stored short summary per session, or should the UI rely on ellipsis truncation of a single field?

'+6 more', 'History · 8 sessions →' and 'Full history →' are not links in the prototype, and L has no footer or count. Confirm that every size should link to the full history page, and whether L also gets a count.
Filter chips (All / Solo / Synergy) appear only at L and XL. At S and M, is filtering moved to the left bar, or unavailable?
'Text never scales' is contradicted by the prototype: S row titles are 14px against 15px elsewhere, and the Credits hero is 28px at S against 34px at M. Are these intentional exceptions?
Mode at S is shown only by dot colour (navy Synergy, grey Solo), with no legend or accessible name. Should it get an aria-label or tooltip, or a different glyph?
Phone behaviour and resize interaction (handles, snapping, the 'Resize' tool flow) are not specified on this board. Confirm that the Phone and Desktop boards are the source for those.
